{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
# Use idxmax to get the index of the row with highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_df = filtered_df.loc[filtered_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = deduplicated_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required values explicitly for grounding
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df) - len(filtered_df)}")
print(f"Final number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated_df)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_baseline}")"}
